content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the NAM Pathanamthitta Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NAM Pathanamthitta Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 13-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National AYUSH Mission, Pathanamthitta (NAM Pathanamthitta) for various healthcare contract positions.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available under NAM Pathanamthitta Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions include Ayurveda Therapist (Male), GNM Nurse, and MPW (Janani Project) under contract basis.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled application form is 13-10-2026 up to 05:00 PM on working days.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply through offline mode by submitting their applications directly or through post to the designated office address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 40 years as on 01/10/2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Ayurveda Therapist (Male)?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Ayurveda Therapist (Male) post will receive a monthly consolidated salary of Rs. 14,700/-.

faq.question: Q7. Where should I send my filled application form?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent to The District Programme Manager, District Programme Management and supporting Unit, National AYUSH Mission, Orikompil Building 2nd Floor, Melevettipuram, Pathanamthitta - 689645.

faq.question: Q8. Will there be a written exam for selection?
faq.answer: Yes, a written test will be conducted along with the interview if the number of applicants for a particular post exceeds 20.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee is specified in the official notification released by National AYUSH Mission, Pathanamthitta.

faq.question: Q10. What documents need to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach self-attested copies of certificates proving age and educational qualifications along with the application form.
